title: Chapter 235 The Battle Of Trapped Beasts
content:
Chapter 235 The Battle Of Trapped Beasts

The sound of war drums and thunder sounded, and soon, large armies began to move, and small groups of armies from both sides slowly came into contact, and then the troops from the rear slowly added, and the battlefield continued to expand, and soon covered the battlefield to a radius of two For more than ten miles, it is covered with small plains.

This time, the coalition forces did not allow Zhong Yu 100,000. They did not treat Qin as they did at the beginning, treating Qin as a wolf and retreating at the first touch.

Instead, he went straight up, bravely pulled out the weapon in his hand, and resolutely killed the stern-faced Qin soldiers.

In the eyes of these soldiers, the Qin army on the opposite side was no longer the tiger wolf they regarded as a great terror, but a food that could only run.

In the eyes of those generals, these Qin troops were not the death knell they thought in the past, and they did not flee in a hurry. Instead, they became stepping stones for them to get promoted and get rich.

It can be said that the morale of the current coalition forces is extremely uplifting, full of fighting spirit to face everything, and dare to go up and break their wrists in the face of any enemy.

But don't really treat the coalition army as an indomitable iron army because of this. The coalition army is just a temporary illusion caused by the temptation of this moment because of long-term suppression. That's all.

It's like a burst of energy. When the energy is blown up, it will be of no avail, but when the energy is exhausted.

Or the coalition forces find that what they think is different from the facts, then they will return to the same as before, becoming the lambs that can be fished at will in the eyes of the Qin army, and become vulnerable.

"However, this army is still barely usable!" Standing on the command platform, Zhong Yu said secretly in his heart.

The two armies soon entered into a fierce battle. Because of the performance of the Han and Yan armies last time, the superiority of the Qin army, which was once again established in the heart, once again encountered a tough bone.

"This time, the coalition forces of Han and Yan did not know what kind of medicine they took by mistake. They are so difficult to deal with, and they are so fearless of death!" Said.

However, different from his lieutenant general's worries, as the commander-in-chief of this army, Wang Jian showed a smile when his army suffered heavy losses and became difficult to move forward, as if he was extremely satisfied with all this.

This made the lieutenant around him feel extremely strange. If the lieutenant hadn't understood that Wang Jian's family was all in Xianyang, the imperial capital, and he himself was closely tied to the state of Qin. He thought Wang Jian was a spy sent by the enemy coalition forces.

Wang Jian, who was in front of the lieutenant general, seemed to sense the doubts of his lieutenant general, smiled, turned his head and said to him:

"This is not surprising. When the beast is dying, it will fight to the death, let alone these enemy troops with weapons in their hands. It's just a flashback. After this period of time, the opposite army will change. Become that weak and powerless lamb, and let me, Qin, slaughter me!"

Hearing what his general said, the deputy general suddenly realized, and nodded in agreement:

"The general is right. The enemies I faced in the past also had the same situation. Now it's just because of the confusion of the previous battles and the fact that the situation is too big to predict, so my mind is confused. Listen to the general now. I found out that this is indeed the case, the general is worthy of being the god of war of our Great Qin, and the strategy has come to this point!"

The lieutenant's words of flattery poured out money, whether it was because Wang Jian was his coach, or he really admired him, anyway, saying these words didn't have the slightest impact on him.

While the two were talking, the army below had been killed terribly, with corpses strewn all over the field, blood flowing like rivers, and broken battle flags constantly spread on the battlefield, being trampled wantonly by the chaotic surrounding soldiers who couldn't find their way.

There were also soldiers from the two armies who were seriously injured, lying on the bed and moaning continuously, but no one came to see him. There are only two fates for these people, either they are dealt with by the passing enemies, or they die slowly and painfully alone.

Today's alliance is in short supply of materials, including medicinal materials, ordinary soldiers like them with mediocre status and low status, on the battlefield, there is no one to take care of them at all.

It is already benevolent of the coalition forces to give them a happy life and let them die without so much torture.

The war continued slowly, and soon after a morning, the morale of the coalition forces at this time had slowly worn down and turned into a low state.

However, because the previous morale was too high, and under the blessing of this morale, the results of the battle were relatively considerable, so the morale of the coalition forces did not drop too much, it just continued to decline slowly.

However, the coalition forces on the battlefield may not have discovered that their combat effectiveness has slowly declined. But outside the battlefield, the commanders-in-chief of the two armies who were looking at the entire battlefield minutely, speculating on the situation, and constantly sending troops and military orders, were keenly aware of this fact.

Among them, Wang Jian, the god of war, is the fastest and most excited. Isn't he waiting for such an opportunity?

The morale of the coalition forces finally couldn't hold it anymore, as long as their last breath of energy was destroyed, then these coalition forces could be said to be abolished.

And without these coalition forces, all it has to face is the imperial army of 60,000 people hiding in the rear as the supervising team.

Compared with the Qin army with more than 200,000 troops left, this mere 60,000 people is really nothing? With Wang Jian's self-confidence, these Qin Guoxiong troops rushed over, and with a flat push, they could be wiped out with a single palm.

Now that the war has been fought, there are still about 100,000 people left in the Qin army, but the coalition army is already only half of the Qin army, with 60,000 people in the early days, and it can no longer support it.

And in some armies, there were already signs of fleeing, but these fleeing people were quickly shot to death by random arrows from the supervisory team behind, as a warning to others.

"His Royal Highness Prince Jing, the army in front is about to lose its hold, should we do something to save the situation!" Han Han, who had aged to the age of seventy in just two years, was by Zhong Yu's side. Wang asked anxiously.

If you want to say who in this world cares most about the victory or defeat of the central coalition forces, it is undoubtedly Han Wang.

Because South Korea is right behind the coalition forces, and all of South Korea's troops are in the coalition forces. If the coalition forces are defeated, it means that South Korea is defeated, and South Korea is not far from extinction.
